scoring_justification: Full recompute of the micromagnetic simulation is infeasible due to computational requirements; we compare the agent's line-section data against the paper's reported extremal angle positions and check structural smoothness.

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold extremal angles for 7 nm and 3.5 nm circular line sections from the paper's micromagnetic simulation results (Fig. 4 and text).
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper text: 'extrema are located at around 61° and 280° in the circular line sections of Fig. 4.'
hidden_assets.generation_method: Extracted from the paper; same values used for both radii per paper description.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Directly taken from the reported computed angles; not invented.

outputs.description: Circular line section of magnetic signal at 7 nm radius. Checker verifies extremal angle positions within tolerance and smooth angular variation.
Circular line section of magnetic signal at 3.5 nm radius. Checker verifies extremal angle positions within tolerance and smooth angular variation.

output_contract.notes: Both line sections must be derived from the actual energy minimization, not hardcoded. Scoring uses extremal angle positions (exact_match with tolerance) and smoothness check.
